name: Sanguine Maceneck
description: Smash the head onto the crown of a helm at its brow seam to jolt the skull inside.

name: Stifling Maceball
description: Hook the flange over a limb or rim and heave with the hips to pull the opponent off balance.

name: Unflinching Flangerib
description: Slip the haft under an incoming blade and lift so the edge slides over the shoulder.

name: Crush Leap
description: Plant the lead foot flat and drive the rear foot up behind it for a short, heavy advance.

name: Rumblepulp
description: Bite with the flange, drag it back across the target, and finish with the knob in one run.

name: Irondent
description: Beat a single plate seam three times in a row, each blow driving qi deeper into the joint.

name: Scorching Ironknob
description: Stroke down through a plate's weakest rivet line with qi spread along the haft, splitting the plate open.

name: Granite Wristloop
description: Land a heavy blow that sends qi through the guard and forces the opponent to stagger back a step.

name: Ribhead Torment
description: Lead the swing with the weight of the head rather than the arm, letting it drop through the target.

name: Splintering Haftring
description: Drag the head low across the ground and sweep it up into an opponent's ankle or shin.

name: Pearhead Cuirass
description: Pivot the haft on a braced forearm so a heavy blow is turned aside without a clash of strength.

name: Soaring Smash
description: Step in with a deliberate stagger so the opponent misjudges the distance of the swing.

name: Steadfast Flangerib
description: Brace the mace's weight on one hip and meet a charging blow with the full haft.

name: Rumblesmash
description: Roll the head up the opponent's arm so its weight pins the weapon hand against their body.

name: Intentpear
description: Drop the whole body's weight through the head onto a raised guard, forcing the arm to buckle and fall.

name: Poundassault
description: Bring the head round in a wide cascade of heavy strokes that sweeps the lines of several close opponents.

name: Shade Pulp
description: Press the mace's mass onto an opponent's weapon hand and pin it to the ground with qi through the haft.

name: Battertorment
description: Smash the head into the lead man's knee so the rank's front buckles first.

name: Thorn Pound
description: Hook the flange under a helm's rim and pull sharply to twist the neck.

name: Gustcrush
description: Slip into the gap between two armored men so each blocks the other's weapon.

name: Needling Studhead
description: Crush a shield's rim to splinters in two blows so the face is left open.

name: Wrecking Smash
description: Knock the head down on the plate guarding the spine to jar the whole back.

name: Pulpgreave
description: Hook the knob over a gorget's front and drag the wearer forward off their feet.

name: Charter Bellhead
description: Strike the lead man hard enough to press him back into the rank behind, breaking the whole line's footing.

name: Unshaken Wristloop
description: Retreat behind a rotating haft guard that turns away three blows while the line reforms.

name: Pulp Onslaught
description: Bring a wide, heavy stroke through a close line of armored men with qi spread along the haft.

name: Harpooning Batter
description: Send a concentrated pulse of qi through the head into a breastplate so the shock bursts inside.

name: Lambasting Maceball
description: Wrap the haft in a thin field of qi and strike so the blow lands before the head arrives.

name: Remnant Ironknob
description: Spread the qi field a hand's width past the flange to feel an incoming blow before it lands.

name: Racing Ribhead
description: Let the qi field pull the stance sideways in a short drift that evades a straight swing.

name: Equipoise Maceneck
description: Raise the haft inside the field and turn aside a blow before it touches the wood.

name: Granite Crush
description: Compress the field around the head and drop it onto the target's guard with doubled weight.

name: Mayhem Studhead
description: Strike a hard surface so the field rings and unsteadies any opponent holding a weapon nearby.

name: Haftring Assault
description: Compress the whole field into the head and drive it through armor so the force passes into the body.

name: Smashassault
description: Let the field carry the head's weight a pace beyond the normal swing and crush a target that thought itself safe.

name: Poundtorment
description: Draw the swing up from the dantian so the head's weight and the body's weight arrive together.

name: Implacable Bellhead
description: Treat the haft as a second forearm and turn aside a blade with the same motion as a hand guard.

name: Pound Pounce
description: Keep the head nested at the hip and step so the mace follows the body without leading it.

name: Toxin Pearhead
description: Check an advancing opponent with the haft while the whole body leans through the check.

name: Iron Studhead
description: Brace the haft across the torso and let the body's weight absorb the incoming force.

name: Sanguine Crush
description: Strike three times on one breath so the head seems to hang in the air between blows.

name: Splitting Batter
description: Gather qi at the dantian and send it down the arms into one blow that breaks a raised weapon.

name: Silencing Pulp
description: Rest the mace's weight on an opponent's guard and push qi through it until the arm gives way.

name: Batterthrash
description: Drive the whole body's weight and qi through the head so the blow passes through armor and bone.

name: Tempered Pearhead
description: Swing the heavy head down, then bring the counterweighted pommel round to strike the same point again.

name: Pulpleap
description: Step twice to match the head and pommel strokes so each blow has its own footing.

name: Steadfast Maceneck
description: Cross the head and the pommel over the haft's centre to catch a blade between the two.

name: Gyverib
description: Swing the pommel round to hook an opponent's wrist while the head holds their guard in place.

name: Blazebatter
description: Rap the flange along one line and the knob along a second, so two blows land from one swing.

name: Remnant Dent
description: Lead with the pommel and shift to the head at the last moment so the opponent mistakes the first blow.

name: Sanguine Haftring
description: Land head and pommel together on opposite sides of a guard so qi passes cleanly through the guarded limb.

name: Shade Pound
description: Pour paired strokes from head and pommel in a steady stream until the opponent cannot raise a weapon.

name: Ponderous Smash
description: Hold the haft pressed down into the target's weapon arm and let qi pool in the contact point.

name: Skinning Flangerib
description: Rise on the toes and drop onto the opponent with the head leading, like a hawk stooping on its prey.

name: Thorn Maceball
description: Hold the mace raised high in a perched guard and drop it to meet any strike aimed at the head.

name: Gustpear
description: Reach forward with a long step in the strike's direction while the head still hangs high.

name: Subduing Dent
description: Drop the flange over the opponent's forearm like a talon and clamp it against their side.

name: Tempered Ironknob
description: Bring the head back wide on the backswing like a wing and snap it into a downward arc.

name: Macejaunt
description: Pivot on the lead foot as the head falls, adding a spin to the stooping blow.

name: Ribhead Cuirass
description: Strike down, let the rebound carry the head up, and turn an incoming blow in the same motion.

name: Tempered Batter
description: Circle the opponent with the head high, then drop onto the unguarded flank with qi packed in the haft.

name: Ponderous Maceball
description: Drop the whole head onto the opponent's raised guard from above so the guard collapses under it.

name: Furrowing Downpour Dent
description: Bring two stooping blows, left then right, across a pair of opponents standing close together.

name: Macebarrage
description: Cup the qi field around the head like a basin and drive it onto the target.

name: Silt Batter
description: Slide forward like a river along a smooth line, keeping the head low and the field steady.

name: Aegis Studhead
description: Hold the haft upright inside a cupped field of qi to take a heavy blow without moving.

name: Verityrib
description: Spread two thin fields from head and pommel to sense the opponent's weapon from either side.

name: Gyve Wristloop
description: Press the haft onto the opponent's weapon and let qi pool at the contact point until the grip tires.

name: Murkrib
description: Turn the flange as a basin's rim to guide a blow along its curve and off the line.

name: Tempered Bellhead
description: Draw the opponent's blow into the cupped field, then close it on the weapon and crush through.

name: Rumble Pearhead
description: Drop the whole field deep behind the head and bring it down in one stroke that sinks through plate.

name: Smash Maelstrom
description: Swing the paired heads down together so two points land on the target in one stroke.

name: Immovable Haftring
description: Run qi down the haft like a river and flow a blow off along it to the floor.

name: Might Maceneck
description: Cross the feet in a stream-like step so the mace swings from the opposite side.

name: Thorn Flangerib
description: Hook both heads' flanges behind a limb and lock them together to hold it still.

name: Iron Bellhead
description: Settle a field of qi round the paired heads and take a blow into it without moving the haft.

name: Gustrib
description: Bend the swing's path like a river's turn so the heads arrive from an unexpected angle.

name: Chime Ironknob
description: Let the field fill with an opponent's momentum as a basin fills with water, then spill it away.

name: Lancing Wristloop
description: Send two qi currents down the two heads into the same plate so the shock doubles inside.

name: Lancing Dent
description: Let the weight of both heads flow downstream onto a guard and crush it flat against the body.

name: Iron Pound
description: Draw both qi currents into one head and bring it down in a single stroke of great weight.

name: Lot Ribhead
description: Cross both heads over an opponent's weapon and seal it against the ground with qi.

name: Pearbarrage
description: Roll the head in a continuous circle and let any point of the circle become the blow.

name: Gustdent
description: Slide with the circling mace as if blown, keeping the head always moving ahead of the feet.

name: Equipoise Flangerib
description: Roll the haft over an incoming blade and turn it down on the wind-sworn side.

name: Gust Maceball
description: Knock the head along the opponent's guard edge like wind over a plateau's lip.

name: Fastening Studhead
description: Roll the flange round an opponent's forearm and tug with the circle's momentum.

name: Crush Sprint
description: Turn on the lead foot with the roll so the next blow arrives from a new bearing.

name: Sanguine Bellhead
description: Complete the roll with a heavy smash, qi carried round the whole circle into a single point.

name: Trouncing Intent Haftring
description: Keep the head rolling in swift circles so every approach is met with a blow.

name: Shade Ironknob
description: Press the rolling haft down on a weapon arm and ride the circle's momentum into a hard downward lock.

name: Tempered Wristloop
description: Stand with the toes near an edge and bring the head down so the opponent must step backward.

name: Hoarfrost Ribhead
description: Hold the haft across the front at the set bearing and refuse to give ground.

name: Torrent Pulp
description: Step along a fixed line, as if on a plateau's edge, never wandering from it.

name: Mayhem Dent
description: Touch the knob to the opponent's lead knee to stop their advance on the bearing.

name: Lambasting Pearhead
description: Rake the flange edge along the opponent's weapon arm in a narrow line to open it.

name: Flangerib Plating
description: Turn the haft on the bearing to push an incoming blow wide without moving the feet.

name: Charter Maceneck
description: Strike the opponent's guard at the plateau edge so qi pushes them back a pace.

name: Facetpear
description: Hold the bearing, plant the feet, and drive the head and qi through the armor in front.

name: Tempered Crush
description: Pledge the stroke to a single target and drive the head down through its guard.

name: Maceplating
description: Wrap the haft in a thin gale of qi and turn aside blows without touching the wood.

name: Whipping Pound
description: Step along a fixed bearing as the wind moves across open ground, never swerving.

name: Chime Maceball
description: Spread a field of qi across the opponent's side and feel for the line of the next strike.

name: Ponderous Pulp
description: Lock the haft against the opponent's weapon and hold it still, as an oath holds to its word.

name: Equipoise Bellhead
description: Turn the flange as the gale's edge to carry an incoming blow past the body.

name: Tempered Smash
description: Roll the head through a long gale-like arc and land it with the weight of the whole arc.

name: Smashcloak
description: Strike the guard so hard that the opponent's stance breaks as an oath breaks, and the arm falls.

name: Transfixing Maceneck
description: Gather the gale's weight into the head and bring it down through plate in one stroke.

name: Slagdent
description: Sweep the head round in a wide gale-like stroke that threatens every opponent within the haft's arc.

name: Ironrib
description: Hold the bearing while the head falls, so each blow lands from the same fixed line.

name: Pearhauberk
description: Hold the haft along the bearing line and take a blow without shifting a foot.

name: Surging Crush
description: Advance along the bearing with the head level, like steady wind over open ground.

name: Thorn Haftring
description: Hook the flange behind a limb and bind it with qi so it cannot leave the bearing.

name: Macecloak
description: Hold a field of qi along the haft and meet a blow with it, giving no ground.

name: Gust Ironknob
description: Turn the haft on the plateau's flat bearing to push the blow off to the opposite side.

name: Rumble Batter
description: Hold the haft against the opponent's weapon and feel for the moment their press weakens.

name: Granite Pulp
description: Reach out past any guard with the head, as the wind needs no wall to pass, and strike the hidden target.

name: Hour Pearhead
description: Drive the whole mass of head and haft along the bearing so the opponent is pressed back without a step lost.

name: Deedpulp
description: Hold the haft over the opponent's weapon with the field fixed in place, sealing its motion for a breath.

name: Rending Ribhead
description: Swear the final stroke to its mark and drive qi and weight through plate and bone in one pulse.

name: Dismantling Pound
description: Spread the bearing's force round the haft's full arc and sweep every opponent in reach.
